coverage_gaps: A dedicated decay-curve uncertainty and annual incremental-stability assessment would be needed before proposing a new monitored recipe. Existing IC means and portfolio uncertainty do not supply that assessment.

decay.cadence_and_delay_interpretation: Monthly beat all three dynamic options in training. Net actual-cost and one-session-delay outcomes are preserved. No horizon or timing changed in response to later observations; monthly is specific to this study.
decay.method_uncertainty_and_caveats: Existing mean IC curves are non-monotone and regime dependent. Training 1/5/10/21-session IC=-0.000252/0.011574/0.006817/0.008922; later=0.021001/0.005240/0.007366/0.004960. No validated exponential model or half-life confidence interval; the horizons have different endpoint-supported samples. Mean curves alone cannot establish a universal lifetime.

inputs.limitations_and_missing_policy: 52 supported histories,51 risky+BIL; BWX/XOP holds. Audited reconstructed prices/raw activity; publication and historical cohort availability uncertified. No missing-data filling or source substitution.

operator_disposition: 2026-11-01: retain Alpha54/the six-signal study as research evidence and move on. Concern that FR25/momentum later gains may be lucky is a hypothesis, not a verified conclusion. No promotion/monitoring authority.
preregistered_net_rule: 2021-2024 only: highest primary5bp/delay0 net Sharpe per alpha and globally, arm-name tie. Compare selected against matching momentum and unranked controls with strict higher Sharpe, CAGR loss<=0.5pp, DD worsening<=2pp. No cost/IC veto. No later rescue. Annual training stability reported; fixed selected policy carried into2025-2026.
prospective_plan_or_gap: No prospective run authorized or started. Any new recipe must freeze selection before genuinely new audited/captured observations; historical replays remain development evidence.

sample.label_boundary_and_overlap: Forward labels stop within each era. Published 1/5/10/21-session daily gross IC uses overlapping labels; net-return uncertainty uses paired circular21-session blocks,4000 draws, not independent daily tests.
sample.prior_search_and_multiplicity: Six formulas, four timings, predeclared study guards; 24 family-adjusted contrasts. Earlier related research and repeated data inspection mean total lifetime search count is unknown. No OOS winner chosen.
